description: NaCa₂Mg₅AlSi₇(O₁₁F)₂ is Esseneite-derived structured and crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. Na is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to two O atoms. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.86 Å. There are five inequivalent Mg sites. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.01-2.10 Å. There is one shorter (2.09 Å) and one longer (2.16 Å) Mg-F bond length. In the second Mg site, Mg is bonded to four O and two F atoms to form MgO₄F₂ octahedra that share corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra and edges with five MgO₄F₂ octahedra. There are three shorter (2.08 Å) and one longer (2.09 Å) Mg-O bond length. There is one shorter (2.06 Å) and one longer (2.07 Å) Mg-F bond length.
